editor_note_en: Editorial summary for orientation, not an authoritative history. Dates given as 'circa' are approximate; events marked 'contested' have competing dates or interpretations, listed under each event. Coordinates are approximate locations for the map.
editor_note_ms: Ringkasan editorial untuk panduan, bukan sejarah berautoriti. Tarikh bertanda 'sekitar' adalah anggaran; peristiwa bertanda 'dipertikaikan' mempunyai tarikh atau tafsiran berbeza yang disenaraikan. Koordinat ialah lokasi anggaran untuk peta.

events.title_en: Human presence at the Niah Caves
events.summary_en: Remains found at the Great Cave of Niah (Sarawak), including the 'Deep Skull', are among the oldest evidence of modern humans in Southeast Asia, dated to roughly 40,000 years ago.
events.summary_ms: Tinggalan di Gua Besar Niah (Sarawak), termasuk 'Deep Skull', antara bukti terawal manusia moden di Asia Tenggara, bertarikh kira-kira 40,000 tahun dahulu.

events.summary_en: A near-complete skeleton found at Gua Gunung Runtuh in the Lenggong Valley, dated to around 10,000–11,000 years ago. The valley's archaeological heritage is a UNESCO World Heritage Site (2012).
events.summary_ms: Rangka hampir lengkap ditemui di Gua Gunung Runtuh, Lembah Lenggong, bertarikh sekitar 10,000–11,000 tahun dahulu. Warisan arkeologi lembah ini disenaraikan sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO (2012).

refs.title: Archaeological Heritage of the Lenggong Valley — UNESCO

events.summary_en: Iron-smelting, port and Hindu-Buddhist religious sites in the Bujang Valley show early participation in Indian Ocean trade during the first millennium CE.
events.summary_ms: Tapak peleburan besi, pelabuhan dan keagamaan Hindu-Buddha di Lembah Bujang menunjukkan penglibatan awal dalam perdagangan Lautan Hindi pada alaf pertama Masihi.
interpretations_en: Some researchers date the Sungai Batu complex to the mid-first millennium BCE; others consider those dates insufficiently established. Both positions are reported here rather than one single date.
interpretations_ms: Sebahagian penyelidik mentarikhkan kompleks Sungai Batu kepada pertengahan alaf pertama SM; yang lain menganggap tarikh itu belum cukup kukuh. Kedua-dua pandangan dicatat di sini, bukan satu tarikh tunggal.

events.summary_en: From about the 7th century, the Sumatra-based thalassocracy of Srivijaya exerted influence over trade ports on the Malay Peninsula.
events.summary_ms: Sejak kira-kira abad ke-7, kerajaan maritim Srivijaya yang berpusat di Sumatera mempengaruhi pelabuhan dagang di Semenanjung Tanah Melayu.

events.summary_en: Melaka was founded around 1400 and grew into the leading entrepôt of the Straits, spreading Islam and a Malay court culture across the region.
events.summary_ms: Melaka dibuka sekitar tahun 1400 dan berkembang menjadi pelabuhan entrepot utama di Selat, menyebarkan Islam dan budaya istana Melayu ke seluruh rantau.
interpretations_en: The founding year is given variously as c. 1400 or 1402.
Sources differ on whether Parameswara and Iskandar Shah were the same person.
interpretations_ms: Tahun pembukaan dicatat sama ada sekitar 1400 atau 1402.
Sumber berbeza sama ada Parameswara dan Iskandar Shah ialah orang yang sama.

events.summary_en: Forces under Afonso de Albuquerque took Melaka in 1511. The sultanate's court moved south, later giving rise to the Johor Sultanate.
events.summary_ms: Angkatan di bawah Afonso de Albuquerque menawan Melaka pada 1511. Istana kesultanan berpindah ke selatan dan kemudiannya membentuk Kesultanan Johor.

events.summary_en: The Dutch East India Company, allied with Johor, captured Melaka from the Portuguese in 1641.
events.summary_ms: Syarikat Hindia Timur Belanda, bersekutu dengan Johor, menawan Melaka daripada Portugis pada 1641.

events.summary_en: Francis Light established a British East India Company settlement on Penang Island, the first British foothold in the Malay states.
events.summary_ms: Francis Light membuka penempatan Syarikat Hindia Timur British di Pulau Pinang, tapak pertama British di negeri-negeri Melayu.
interpretations_en: Kedah's sultanate regarded the arrangement as a conditional lease tied to military protection that was not honoured; British accounts treat it as a cession.
interpretations_ms: Kesultanan Kedah menganggap perjanjian itu pajakan bersyarat berkait perlindungan ketenteraan yang tidak ditunaikan; catatan British menganggapnya penyerahan.

events.summary_en: Britain and the Netherlands divided their spheres of influence along the Straits of Malacca; Melaka passed to Britain.
events.summary_ms: Britain dan Belanda membahagikan lingkungan pengaruh di sepanjang Selat Melaka; Melaka diserahkan kepada Britain.

events.summary_en: Penang, Melaka and Singapore were grouped as the Straits Settlements under the East India Company (a Crown colony from 1867).
events.summary_ms: Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura disatukan sebagai Negeri-Negeri Selat di bawah Syarikat Hindia Timur (tanah jajahan Mahkota mulai 1867).

events.title_en: James Brooke becomes Rajah of Sarawak
events.summary_en: The Brunei sultanate granted Sarawak to James Brooke, beginning a century of rule by the 'White Rajahs'.
events.summary_ms: Kesultanan Brunei menyerahkan Sarawak kepada James Brooke, memulakan pemerintahan 'Rajah Putih' selama satu abad.

events.summary_en: The treaty introduced a British Resident in Perak whose advice had to be followed on all matters except Malay religion and custom — the start of indirect rule in the peninsula.
events.summary_ms: Perjanjian ini memperkenalkan Residen British di Perak yang nasihatnya wajib diikuti kecuali dalam hal agama dan adat Melayu — permulaan pemerintahan tidak langsung di Semenanjung.

events.title_ms: Syarikat Borneo Utara British diberi piagam
events.summary_en: A royal charter allowed the British North Borneo Company to administer North Borneo (today's Sabah).
events.summary_ms: Piagam diraja membenarkan Syarikat Borneo Utara British mentadbir Borneo Utara (Sabah hari ini).
interpretations_en: The 1878 agreement with the Sultanate of Sulu is read as a cession by some and as a lease by others; the Philippines maintains a territorial claim to eastern Sabah, which Malaysia rejects.
interpretations_ms: Perjanjian 1878 dengan Kesultanan Sulu ditafsir sebagai penyerahan oleh sesetengah pihak dan pajakan oleh pihak lain; Filipina mengekalkan tuntutan wilayah ke atas Sabah timur, yang ditolak Malaysia.

events.summary_en: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang were federated under a Resident-General, with Kuala Lumpur as the administrative centre.
events.summary_ms: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang disatukan di bawah Residen Jeneral, dengan Kuala Lumpur sebagai pusat pentadbiran.

events.summary_en: Siam transferred its claims over Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu and Perlis to Britain; these became the Unfederated Malay States together with Johor.
events.summary_ms: Siam menyerahkan tuntutannya ke atas Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu dan Perlis kepada Britain; negeri-negeri ini bersama Johor menjadi Negeri-Negeri Melayu Tidak Bersekutu.

events.summary_en: Japanese forces landed at Kota Bharu on 8 December 1941; Malaya and Borneo were occupied until Japan's surrender in 1945.
events.summary_ms: Tentera Jepun mendarat di Kota Bharu pada 8 Disember 1941; Tanah Melayu dan Borneo diduduki sehingga Jepun menyerah kalah pada 1945.

events.title_en: Malayan Union and the founding of UMNO
events.summary_en: Britain's Malayan Union reduced the rulers' sovereignty and offered broad citizenship; Malay opposition led to the founding of UMNO (May 1946) and the scheme's replacement.
events.summary_ms: Malayan Union oleh Britain mengurangkan kedaulatan raja-raja dan menawarkan kerakyatan yang luas; bantahan orang Melayu membawa kepada penubuhan UMNO (Mei 1946) dan penggantian skim itu.

events.summary_en: The Federation of Malaya replaced the Malayan Union, restoring the position of the Malay rulers.
events.summary_ms: Persekutuan Tanah Melayu menggantikan Malayan Union dan mengembalikan kedudukan raja-raja Melayu.

events.summary_en: An armed conflict between Commonwealth forces and the Malayan National Liberation Army; the state of emergency was lifted in July 1960.
events.summary_ms: Konflik bersenjata antara pasukan Komanwel dan Tentera Pembebasan Nasional Malaya; darurat ditamatkan pada Julai 1960.
interpretations_en: Termed an 'Emergency' by the colonial government (with insurance and legal implications); the communist side called it an anti-British national liberation war.
interpretations_ms: Dinamakan 'Darurat' oleh kerajaan kolonial (berkait implikasi insurans dan undang-undang); pihak komunis menggelarnya perang pembebasan nasional anti-British.

events.title_en: Independence of the Federation of Malaya
events.summary_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaimed independence at Stadium Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, on 31 August 1957.
events.summary_ms: Tunku Abdul Rahman mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan di Stadium Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, pada 31 Ogos 1957.

events.summary_en: Sarawak attained self-government on 22 July 1963, commemorated as Sarawak Day; North Borneo followed on 31 August 1963.
events.summary_ms: Sarawak mencapai pemerintahan sendiri pada 22 Julai 1963, diraikan sebagai Hari Sarawak; Borneo Utara menyusul pada 31 Ogos 1963.

events.summary_en: Malaya, Singapore, North Borneo (Sabah) and Sarawak federated as Malaysia under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 (MA63).
events.summary_ms: Tanah Melayu, Singapura, Borneo Utara (Sabah) dan Sarawak bersekutu sebagai Malaysia di bawah Perjanjian Malaysia 1963 (MA63).
interpretations_en: The scope of Sabah's and Sarawak's rights under MA63 remains the subject of ongoing federal–state negotiation.
Indonesia opposed the federation (Konfrontasi, 1963–1966) and the Philippines maintained its claim to Sabah.
interpretations_ms: Skop hak Sabah dan Sarawak di bawah MA63 masih dirunding antara kerajaan Persekutuan dan negeri.
Indonesia menentang pembentukan persekutuan (Konfrontasi, 1963–1966) dan Filipina mengekalkan tuntutannya ke atas Sabah.

events.summary_en: Singapore left the federation and became an independent republic on 9 August 1965.
events.summary_ms: Singapura keluar daripada persekutuan dan menjadi republik merdeka pada 9 Ogos 1965.

events.summary_en: Sectarian violence in Kuala Lumpur after the general election led to a national emergency and parliament's suspension until 1971.
events.summary_ms: Rusuhan kaum di Kuala Lumpur selepas pilihan raya umum membawa kepada darurat negara dan penggantungan Parlimen sehingga 1971.
interpretations_en: The official death toll was 196; other accounts give substantially higher figures. Causes and responsibility are debated by historians.
interpretations_ms: Angka rasmi kematian ialah 196; catatan lain memberikan angka yang jauh lebih tinggi. Punca dan tanggungjawab masih dibahaskan oleh ahli sejarah.

events.summary_en: The NEP set the twin goals of eradicating poverty and restructuring society to reduce the identification of race with economic function.
events.summary_ms: DEB menetapkan matlamat serampang dua mata: membasmi kemiskinan dan menyusun semula masyarakat bagi menghapuskan pengenalan kaum dengan fungsi ekonomi.

events.title_en: Kuala Lumpur becomes a Federal Territory
events.summary_en: Kuala Lumpur was separated from Selangor and placed under federal administration. Labuan (1984) and Putrajaya (2001) followed.
events.summary_ms: Kuala Lumpur dipisahkan daripada Selangor dan diletakkan di bawah pentadbiran Persekutuan. Labuan (1984) dan Putrajaya (2001) menyusul.

events.summary_en: The ringgit fell sharply; in September 1998 Malaysia pegged the ringgit and imposed selective capital controls.
events.summary_ms: Nilai ringgit jatuh mendadak; pada September 1998 Malaysia menambat ringgit dan mengenakan kawalan modal terpilih.

events.summary_en: The planned federal administrative centre was declared a Federal Territory.
events.summary_ms: Pusat pentadbiran Persekutuan yang dirancang diisytiharkan sebagai Wilayah Persekutuan.

events.title_en: 14th General Election: first change of federal government
events.summary_en: The Pakatan Harapan coalition won the election, the first change of federal government since independence.
events.summary_ms: Gabungan Pakatan Harapan memenangi pilihan raya, pertukaran kerajaan Persekutuan pertama sejak merdeka.

events.title_en: Population and Housing Census of Malaysia 2020
events.summary_en: DOSM conducted the 2020 census, the first in Malaysia to use online self-enumeration at scale; it is the benchmark for current population estimates.
events.summary_ms: DOSM melaksanakan Banci 2020, banci pertama di Malaysia yang menggunakan banci kendiri dalam talian secara meluas; ia menjadi tanda aras anggaran penduduk semasa.
